title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred State College on 1970-05-01
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Charlie Miller soundboard delivers an exceptional 1970 acoustic set (Race Is On, Wake Up Little Susie) plus a strong electric second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its astonishing clarity and balance – listeners can crank it up loud and still hear every instrument, even hidden acoustic guitar parts. The show itself ranks among the band’s best early‑70s acoustic performances with tight, energetic renditions of Race Is On, Wake Up Little Susie, New Speedway and a solid electric second set, though one reviewer noted an isolated fade‑out glitch.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average 4.3) and overwhelmingly positive comments about both performance and recording quality; only a single outlier complaint about a fade‑out.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Exceptional clarity, crisp mix, full dynamic range – reviewers can hear all instruments clearly; one minor issue noted with a harsh fade‑out on a track.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic first set hailed as one of the best, with energetic tightness; second electric set described as good and the overall flow praised for maintaining high energy throughout.
